diagnosis.action: Repair sign before tuning learning rate; compare at nonstationary points.
diagnosis.interpretation: A nonzero gradient with reversed sign gives an uphill local update; zero gradients cannot expose this sign error.

diagnosis.action: Restore row pairing and require residual shape exactly (n,).
diagnosis.interpretation: Cross-pairing defines a different objective; matching its own finite differences cannot establish intended row pairing.

diagnosis.action: Keep logits; do not use nanmean or clip away the evidence.
diagnosis.interpretation: Compare each case with the finite signed-softplus result, including representable small tails.

diagnosis.action: Check update scale and representability together with gradient norm.
diagnosis.interpretation: A small step with a large gradient is stagnation, not stationarity.

diagnosis.action: After checking gradient and objective, reduce learning rate or use justified step selection.
diagnosis.interpretation: A downhill local direction can still increase the loss after a large finite step.

scope: Synthetic deterministic diagnostic experiment; no generalization claim.

semantics.primary_objective: mean of paired half squared residuals
semantics.stability_objective: separate mean binary signed-softplus loss on same rows
